metadata.dcterms:title: Generalized Markov traces and Jucys-Murphy elements
metadata.dcterms:creator: Kostiantyn Tolmachov, Heorhii Zhylinskyi
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We give a simple construction of Markov traces for Iwahori-Hecke algebras associated with infinite series of crystallographic Coxeter groups. In types B and D it is new, and generalizes a known construction in type A employing symmetric polynomials in multiplicative Jucys-Murphy elements.
